proof_domain: The host admits only byte-identical archived WGSL and the byte-identical 2240-byte primary uniform, after successful Naga parsing and validation. It does not rewrite any mathematical expression or authored guard.
The source profile count is finite integral 45. More generally the layer-loop argument requires integral count in 2..128, but this control does NOT admit different uniforms.

Keep ShaderRuntimeChecks::checked() except force_loop_bounding=false. All buffer/array access and integer division checks remain unchanged. No shader pruning or alternative numerical variant is admitted.

No geometric-packet correctness premise is needed for termination: every BVH traversal has its own shared finite visit counter before pointer-dependent control, and every leaf-face count is masked to 1..8. Geometric packet identity/physical correctness remains the existing independent fixture/provenance contract.

WGSL validation excludes recursion. The finite set of functions listed here includes the entire source, not merely a guessed reachable subset. Functions without loops perform finite straight-line operations and finite calls.

Floating-point nonconvergence, NaN or lack of physical progress cannot create an infinite loop: progress guards below are integer counters unaffected by ray arithmetic. This does not claim a useful worst-case GPU runtime or exclude watchdog failure.

loops.proof: i is an unmodified i32 outside its increment; at most 5 iterations. Exact-normal early break can only shorten it.
At most 8 binary-search iterations, independently of floating-point comparisons. Initially lo=0, hi=count-1; updates preserve 0<=lo<=hi<=count-1.

Search has at most 8 iterations. With count in 2..128 and lo in 0..count-1, first=max(lo-1,0), last=min(lo+1,count-2)<=126. The inclusive loop runs at most 3 times, or zero when first>last. Its increment cannot wrap. WGSL select may evaluate lo-1 at zero, but selects first=0; it does not make the loop unbounded.

Vacuum bracketing/search are capped at 40 and 32. Outer trace has at most 4096 attempts, including rejection/continue paths. Both nested height-root refinements have at most 20 iterations per call. No body assignment changes these i/j counters; i32 increments remain far below overflow.
At most 3 axes; early rejection only shortens the loop.
At most 24 root-refinement iterations even when finite arithmetic cannot shrink the bracket. advance_delta has no unbounded loops.

Both nested traversals share visited initialized to 0. Every entered iteration first tests its pointer exit, then increments visited and immediately returns if visited>8192, BEFORE pointer-dependent continue/face work. At most 8193 combined counter increments per function call; at most 8192 iterations reach node work. There is no reset/decrement, so u32 wrap is impossible even for cyclic/out-of-range pointers. count=((leaf>>24)&7)+1 is in 1..8; leaf loop therefore cannot wrap.

visited initialized to 0; each entered traversal iteration increments it before any pointer-dependent continue and returns above 2048. At most 2049 increments, no reset/decrement/wrap. Each leaf has exactly bounded 8-corner and 14-face loops.

The same two-level shared visited invariant as terrain_events gives at most 8193 counter increments per function call, independently of pointer progress. Leaf count is in 1..8. A found covering triangle only returns earlier.
